facts.claim: Mary Rose Mission advertises hot meals every day, 4–5:30 p.m., at 272 Main Street in Florence. Confirm holiday or weather changes before travelling.
quote: We are proud to serve a hot meal every day from 4:00 until 5:30!
The Mary Rose Mission owns a building at 272 Main Street in Florence

facts.claim: The mission’s About page describes volunteers carrying trays to tables for older guests and guests needing additional support, with a greeter at the door. This describes meal assistance; transfer help, personal care and a step-free entrance are not established.
facts.quote: They will help with the children and will assist the elderly and special needs guests by carrying their trays to the tables. We have a “greeter” at the door welcoming our guests to dinner

facts.claim: The contact page lists weekday office hours as 10 a.m.–3 p.m., while its footer says 9 a.m.–3 p.m. Call 859-292-0300 before an office visit. These are office hours, separate from the evening meal service.
The homepage says all are welcome. It does not specify a reservation procedure, eligibility documents or a meal price; ask the mission about any dietary or other support needed before visiting.
